systems.system: Système d'Information et de Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Éducation nationale, Cellule de Planification et de la Statistique du secteur de l'éducation (CPS-SE); UNESCO and IIPE give technical and financial support for school-health indicators (O3 programme, capacity building since 2021)
systems.tiers: national data collection by academic year (2023-2024 and 2024-2025 analysed at a workshop at Fana, 11-15 March 2026); no tier of entry stated

note: No fact: the SIGE is described only as a national collection producing statistics by academic year, to which school-health indicators have been added; nothing says schools enter per-learner records, so it is class census.
